summary: Veracyte filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger on September 10, 2026 and completion on September 14, 2026 of its acquisition of Convergent Genomics Inc. via reverse subsidiary merger, making Convergent a wholly owned subsidiary. Veracyte paid $150M cash upfront, subject to customary cash, debt, transaction expense and net working capital adjustments, plus up to $30M in milestone-based cash tied to UroAmp publications and reimbursement. The deal adds UroAmp urine tumor DNA bladder cancer diagnostics to Veracyte's roadmap. No board recommendation, premium, or advisors were disclosed in the excerpt. Watch milestone achievement and integration risk.
